title: 3114 national suicide-prevention line
fact_en: In France, the national suicide-prevention number is 3114. It is free, answered 24/7 across the whole country by a health professional trained in suicide prevention, for people in distress and for those worried about someone else.
fact_ko: 프랑스의 국가 자살예방 전화번호는 3114이다. 무료이며 전국에서 24시간 연중무휴로, 자살 예방 교육을 받은 의료 전문가가 위기에 처한 본인과 주변 사람을 상담한다.
legal_basis: Code de la santé publique art. L3221-1 (politique de santé mentale et prévention du suicide)
common_misconceptions: 15 (SAMU) is the only number to call for suicidal crisis
3114 is only open on weekdays during office hours
3114 is a paid premium-rate number
3919 / 3977 are the suicide-prevention lines

title: Emergency numbers 15 (SAMU) and 112
fact_en: Of the 12 free emergency numbers in France, 15 reaches the SAMU (Emergency Medical Aid Service), 17 police/gendarmerie, 18 firefighters and 112 is the European emergency number. 0 800 112 112 only calls back and does not take emergency calls.
fact_ko: 프랑스에는 12개의 무료 긴급번호가 있으며, 15는 SAMU(응급의료지원서비스), 17은 경찰·헌병, 18은 소방, 112는 유럽 공통 긴급번호이다. 0 800 112 112는 회신 전용이며 긴급 신고를 직접 받지 않는다.
legal_basis: Code de la santé publique art. L6311-1 et s. (aide médicale urgente); Service-Public.fr (DILA), Numéros d'urgence
common_misconceptions: Only 911 or 999 work in France
15 is the police number (17 is)
112 only works for foreign tourists
Calling 0 800 112 112 connects you to emergency services

title: Access to your medical file: 8 days / 2 months
fact_en: A patient may ask for their medical file directly. The file must be sent at the latest within eight days of the request and not earlier than 48 hours after it; if the information is more than five years old the deadline is two months.
fact_ko: 환자는 자신의 진료기록을 직접 요청할 수 있다. 기록은 요청 후 늦어도 8일 이내, 그리고 48시간 이후에 제공되어야 하며, 정보가 5년 넘은 경우 기한은 2개월이다.
legal_basis: Code de la santé publique art. L1111-7 et R1111-1 à R1111-8
common_misconceptions: 30 days (the GDPR default one month applies instead of the CSP deadline)
The doctor may refuse because the file is his property
Access must always go through a doctor of your choice
The deadline is always 2 months

title: Carte Vitale app open to all insured persons
fact_en: Since 18 November 2025 the digital carte Vitale (smartphone app) is open to everyone insured under the French social security system, whatever their scheme; it can be activated by video check of an ID document and face, without a French e-ID card. The physical card remains valid.
fact_ko: 2025년 11월 18일부터 디지털 카르트 비탈(스마트폰 앱)은 가입 제도와 관계없이 프랑스 사회보장 가입자 모두에게 개방되었으며, 신분증과 얼굴 영상 확인으로 전자신분증 없이도 활성화할 수 있다. 실물 카드도 계속 유효하다.
legal_basis: Code de la sécurité sociale art. L161-31 (carte Vitale); Service-Public.fr (DILA), actualité A18126
recent_change_note: Since 18 Nov 2025 the app activation is open to all insured (previously only holders of the CNIe via France Identité since 18 Mar 2025).
common_misconceptions: The app is reserved to holders of the French electronic ID card (CNIe)
The app replaces the physical card, which becomes invalid
Only the general scheme (CPAM) insured can use it
Activation costs a fee

title: Mon espace santé: 6-week opt-out
fact_en: Mon espace santé (the national digital health space including the shared medical record, DMP) is opened automatically 6 weeks after the letter or email unless the person objects; one can still close the account at any time, or ask for its creation later.
fact_ko: Mon espace santé(공유 진료기록 DMP를 포함한 국가 디지털 건강 공간)는 서신 또는 이메일 발송 6주 후 반대하지 않으면 자동 개설된다. 이후에도 언제든 계정을 폐쇄하거나 나중에 개설을 요청할 수 있다.
legal_basis: Code de la santé publique art. L1111-13-1 et s. (espace numérique de santé)
common_misconceptions: Opt-out is possible only within 2 weeks
Once created, the account cannot be closed
Opening requires explicit consent beforehand
It is run by private insurers (mutuelles)

title: Deposit guarantee EUR 100,000 (FGDR)
fact_en: If a bank cannot return its customers' deposits, the Fonds de Garantie des Dépôts et de Résolution (FGDR, Deposit Guarantee and Resolution Fund) compensates up to EUR 100,000 per client and per institution, within 7 working days.
fact_ko: 은행이 고객 예금을 돌려줄 수 없는 경우 예금보증·정리기금(FGDR)이 고객당·금융기관당 최대 10만 유로를 영업일 기준 7일 이내에 보상한다.
legal_basis: Code monétaire et financier art. L312-4 à L312-16; Directive 2014/49/UE
common_misconceptions: EUR 50,000 per account
EUR 100,000 per account (not per client and institution)
EUR 70,000 as in the old regime
Payout takes 3 months

title: Unauthorised card payment: refund by next business day, 13-month limit
fact_en: If a card payment was not authorised, the bank must refund all debited sums immediately and at the latest by the end of the first business day after receiving the dispute. A fraudulent payment cannot be refunded if it is older than 13 months (70 days outside the EEA).
fact_ko: 승인하지 않은 카드 결제의 경우 은행은 이의 접수 후 즉시, 늦어도 다음 영업일 말까지 차감된 전액을 환급해야 한다. 13개월이 지난 부정 결제는 환급받을 수 없다(EEA 밖 결제는 70일).
legal_basis: Code monétaire et financier art. L133-18 et L133-24; Directive (UE) 2015/2366 (DSP2)
common_misconceptions: The bank has 30 days to refund
The refund is only due if a police complaint was filed first
Limit is 6 months
The customer always bears the first EUR 150

title: 14-day withdrawal right (distance sales) and 2026 reform for financial services
fact_en: Consumers buying at a distance (internet, phone, mail) have at least 14 calendar days to withdraw. For distance financial services, an ordinance of 5 January 2026 strengthens information duties and simplifies withdrawal (including electronically) from 19 June 2026, with some measures later.
fact_ko: 원거리 구매(인터넷·전화·우편) 소비자는 최소 14일(역일) 동안 철회할 수 있다. 원거리 금융서비스에 대해서는 2026년 1월 5일 오르도낭스가 2026년 6월 19일부터 정보 의무를 강화하고 철회를 (전자적 방식 포함) 간소화하며, 일부 조치는 이후 시행된다.
legal_basis: Code de la consommation art. L221-18; art. L222-7; ordonnance du 5 janvier 2026
recent_change_note: Reform of distance marketing of financial services applies from 19 June 2026 (simpler withdrawal, stricter telephone canvassing), some measures at later dates.
common_misconceptions: Withdrawal period is 7 days (old rule)
Withdrawal period is 30 days for all distance contracts
A reason must always be given to withdraw
Withdrawal applies to all goods, including customised ones

title: Bank ombudsman: free, after 2 months (15 days for payment services)
fact_en: After a written complaint to the bank, a customer can refer the dispute to the bank's ombudsman (médiateur) if the answer is unsatisfactory or absent after 2 months (15 days for a payment-service dispute). The mediation is free and the ombudsman must propose a solution within 90 days.
fact_ko: 은행에 서면 불만을 제기한 뒤 답변이 만족스럽지 않거나 2개월(결제서비스 분쟁은 15일) 내 답이 없으면 은행 조정관(médiateur)에게 분쟁을 회부할 수 있다. 조정은 무료이며 조정관은 90일 이내 해결안을 제시해야 한다.
legal_basis: Code monétaire et financier art. L316-1; Code de la consommation art. L611-1 et s.
common_misconceptions: Ombudsman can be seized immediately without complaining to the bank
Mediation costs a fee proportional to the amount
Ombudsman decision is binding
Ombudsman handles loan refusals

title: AMF does not cold-contact savers
fact_en: The AMF (Autorité des marchés financiers, the financial markets regulator) states that it does not contact savers on its own initiative by phone or private messaging; such contacts claiming to be the AMF are likely scams.
fact_ko: 금융시장청(AMF)은 자체적으로 전화나 개인 메시지로 저축자에게 연락하지 않는다고 밝히고 있으며, AMF를 사칭한 이런 연락은 사기일 가능성이 높다.
legal_basis: Code monétaire et financier art. L621-1 (missions de l'AMF, protection de l'épargne)
common_misconceptions: The AMF phones savers to confirm investments
The AMF runs phone awareness campaigns on scams
Contact by the AMF by private message is a normal verification
The Banque de France calls to secure accounts

title: Legal aid (aide juridictionnelle) total ceiling
fact_en: Legal aid (aide juridictionnelle) covers lawyer and court fees; a person living alone gets full (100%) aid if the reference tax income (revenu fiscal de référence) does not exceed EUR 12,957 and assets stay under the asset ceilings. Above it, partial aid may still be possible.
fact_ko: 법률구조(aide juridictionnelle)는 변호사 및 소송 비용을 지원한다. 1인 가구는 기준 소득(revenu fiscal de référence)이 12,957유로를 넘지 않고 자산이 상한 이내이면 전액(100%) 지원을 받으며, 초과해도 일부 지원이 가능할 수 있다.
legal_basis: Loi n° 91-647 du 10 juillet 1991 art. 4 et 41; décret n° 2020-1717
common_misconceptions: Legal aid is only for criminal cases
Ceiling is EUR 1,000 per month
Exceeding the income ceiling means no aid of any kind
Foreigners are always excluded

title: Tenant deposit: return in 1 or 2 months, 10% penalty, 3 years to sue
fact_en: The landlord must return the security deposit within 1 month of the key handover (2 months if repairs/arrears are claimed). Each month of delay started adds a penalty of 10% of monthly rent excluding charges, and the tenant has 3 years from the due date to go to court.
fact_ko: 임대인은 열쇠 반환일로부터 1개월 이내(수리·연체 공제 시 2개월)에 보증금을 돌려주어야 한다. 지연 1개월(시작된 달 기준)마다 관리비 제외 월세의 10%가 가산되며, 세입자는 반환 기한일로부터 3년 이내에 소송을 제기해야 한다.
legal_basis: Loi n° 89-462 du 6 juillet 1989 art. 22
common_misconceptions: Deposit must be returned within 15 days
Penalty is 1% of rent per day
Tenant may withhold the last month's rent against the deposit
Limitation period is 30 years

title: Défenseur des droits: discrimination complaint, 3928
fact_en: A victim or witness of discrimination can contact the Défenseur des droits (Defender of Rights, an independent constitutional authority) free of charge by phone on 3928 (Monday to Saturday, 9:30-19:00 excluding public holidays) or online.
fact_ko: 차별의 피해자나 목격자는 독립 헌법기관인 권리옹호관(Défenseur des droits)에 무료로 전화 3928(월~토 9시30분~19시, 공휴일 제외) 또는 온라인으로 연락할 수 있다.
legal_basis: Constitution art. 71-1; loi organique n° 2011-333 du 29 mars 2011
common_misconceptions: The Defender can be seized only by lawyers
Seizing the Defender suspends all limitation periods
It costs a filing fee
The number is 3919

title: CNIL complaint: wait one month after your request
fact_en: If an organisation has not answered a data-rights request (access, erasure) after one month, you can turn to the CNIL (the French data protection authority); if the answer is incomplete or wrong, first contest it with the organisation.
fact_ko: 기관이 정보 권리 요청(열람·삭제)에 1개월이 지나도록 답하지 않으면 CNIL(프랑스 개인정보보호기관)에 신고할 수 있으며, 답변이 불완전하거나 틀린 경우 먼저 해당 기관에 이의를 제기해야 한다.
legal_basis: RGPD art. 12(3) et 77; loi n° 78-17 du 6 janvier 1978
common_misconceptions: Complaint can be filed to the CNIL only after 3 months
A lawyer is mandatory
The CNIL awards damages directly
Complaint can be filed without any prior contact with the organisation

title: Limitation: IOU prescribed 5 years after due date
fact_en: A reconnaissance de dette (acknowledgement of debt) is time-barred 5 years after the date it falls due; the parties may agree in writing to a shorter or longer period, but not below 1 year or above 10 years.
fact_ko: 차용증(reconnaissance de dette)은 변제기일로부터 5년이 지나면 시효로 소멸하며, 당사자는 서면으로 더 짧거나 긴 기간을 정할 수 있으나 1년 미만 또는 10년 초과는 불가하다.
legal_basis: Code civil art. 2224 et 2254
common_misconceptions: 30 years from signature
2 years from signature
10 years from signature in all cases
Prescription runs from the date of signature, not due date

title: Access to administrative documents: 1 month, then Cada within 2 months
fact_en: The administration must communicate a requested administrative document within one month; silence for one month means refusal. You then have 2 months to refer the matter to the Cada (Commission d'accès aux documents administratifs), which is free and mandatory before going to court.
fact_ko: 행정은 요청된 행정문서를 1개월 이내에 제공해야 하며, 1개월간 무응답은 거부를 뜻한다. 이후 2개월 이내에 Cada(행정문서접근위원회)에 회부할 수 있으며, 이는 무료이고 소송 전에 필수이다.
legal_basis: Code des relations entre le public et l'administration art. L311-1, L311-2, R311-13, R343-1
common_misconceptions: Silence for one month means the request is accepted
The deadline is 15 days
You may go directly to the court without Cada
The Cada decision is binding

title: Allô Service Public 3939
fact_en: Allô Service Public 3939 is a telephone administrative-information service (rights, obligations, procedures). From mainland France it is a free service (call cost depends on the operator); opening hours are Mon 8:30-18:15, Tue and Wed 8:30-13:00, Thu 8:30-18:15, Fri 13:00-17:00, and a free call-back within 45 minutes is possible.
fact_ko: Allô Service Public 3939는 전화로 행정 정보(권리·의무·절차)를 제공하는 서비스이다. 프랑스 본토에서는 서비스 자체는 무료(통화료는 통신사에 따름)이며, 운영 시간은 월 8:30-18:15, 화·수 8:30-13:00, 목 8:30-18:15, 금 13:00-17:00이고 45분 이내 무료 회신 요청이 가능하다.
legal_basis: Service-Public.fr (DILA), Qu'est-ce qu'Allô Service Public 3939 ?
common_misconceptions: Open 24/7
Premium rate of EUR 0.80/min
It is the emergency line for administrative problems
It processes your file or applications directly

title: Electoral registration deadline unified: 6th Friday before the vote
fact_en: From 1 July 2026, the deadline to register on electoral lists is the same whether you go to the town hall or register online: the 6th Friday before the election (previously the 6th Wednesday for online registration), under a decree of 12 June 2026.
fact_ko: 2026년 7월 1일부터 선거인명부 등록 마감은 시청 방문이든 온라인이든 동일하게 선거 전 6번째 금요일이다(이전 온라인은 6번째 수요일). 2026년 6월 12일 데크레에 따른다.
legal_basis: Code électoral art. L30 et s.; décret du 12 juin 2026
recent_change_note: Since 1 July 2026 online and in-person registration share the same deadline (6th Friday before the vote); online was the 6th Wednesday before.
common_misconceptions: Online registration closes on the 6th Wednesday before the vote
Registration is possible until election eve
The deadline is 31 December of the previous year (old rule)
Registration is automatic for everyone aged 18

title: Next national election: presidential, 18 April and 2 May 2027
fact_en: The next national election in France is the presidential election: first round on 18 April 2027 and second round on 2 May 2027 (mainland France; overseas dates differ).
fact_ko: 프랑스의 다음 전국 선거는 대통령 선거로, 1차 투표는 2027년 4월 18일, 결선은 2027년 5월 2일이다(본토 기준, 해외 영토는 날짜가 다름).
legal_basis: Constitution art. 7; loi organique n° 62-1292 du 6 novembre 1962
recent_change_note: Presidential election scheduled for 18 April / 2 May 2027 (mainland).
common_misconceptions: Election is in June 2027
Only one round is held
Voting is on a weekday
The date is 24 April 2027

title: France Identité for French residents overseas and abroad (May 2026)
fact_en: Since May 2026, French citizens living overseas or abroad can create their France Identité digital identity at a town hall, embassy or consulate; before they often could not because they lacked access to FranceConnect (the state authentication scheme using existing verified accounts).
fact_ko: 2026년 5월부터 해외 영토 또는 외국에 거주하는 프랑스인은 시청·대사관·영사관에서 디지털 신원 France Identité를 만들 수 있다. 이전에는 기존 인증 계정을 이용하는 국가 인증체계 FranceConnect에 접근할 수 없어 어려운 경우가 많았다.
legal_basis: Service-Public.fr (DILA), actualité A18920; décret n° 2022-676 du 26 avril 2022 (identité numérique)
recent_change_note: New procedure announced 22 May 2026 for French citizens in overseas territories and abroad.
common_misconceptions: France Identité is mandatory for every citizen
It can only be created online without any in-person step
It is reserved to residents of mainland France
FranceConnect is a private bank service

title: 3018: single national number for school bullying and cyberbullying
fact_en: The 3018 is the national number for victims of bullying, including school bullying and cyberbullying: free, anonymous, open 7 days a week from 9:00 to 23:00, also via app and e-enfance.org.
fact_ko: 3018은 학교 폭력(따돌림)과 사이버 괴롭힘 피해자를 위한 전국 번호로, 무료·익명이며 매일 9시~23시에 운영되고 앱과 e-enfance.org로도 이용할 수 있다.
legal_basis: Code de l'éducation art. L511-3-1 (droit à une scolarité sans harcèlement); Service-Public.fr (DILA)
common_misconceptions: 3020 is the current number for school bullying
3018 only handles online harassment
3018 is open 24/7
119 is the school bullying line

title: Compulsory instruction from age 3 to 16
fact_en: In France children aged 3 to 16 are subject to compulsory instruction: they must be enrolled in a public or private school, or, under conditions and with authorisation, receive instruction in the family.
fact_ko: 프랑스에서는 3세부터 16세까지의 아동이 의무교육 대상이며, 공립 또는 사립학교에 등록하거나 조건과 허가에 따라 가정에서 교육받아야 한다.
legal_basis: Code de l'éducation art. L131-1 et L131-2
common_misconceptions: Compulsory schooling starts at 6
It ends at 18
It ends at 14
Home instruction needs no authorisation

title: Digital consent: parental consent required under 15
fact_en: For processing personal data based on consent, French law requires the joint consent of a minor and a parent when the minor is under 15; from 15 a minor can consent alone for online services (GDPR Art. 8 age set at 15 in France).
fact_ko: 동의에 기반한 개인정보 처리에서 프랑스 법은 15세 미만 미성년자의 경우 미성년자와 부모의 공동 동의를 요구하며, 15세부터는 온라인 서비스에 단독으로 동의할 수 있다(GDPR 제8조 연령을 프랑스는 15세로 설정).
legal_basis: Loi n° 78-17 du 6 janvier 1978 art. 45; RGPD art. 8
common_misconceptions: The age is 16 (GDPR default)
The age is 13
The age is 18
A 15-year-old needs parental consent for every online service

title: Unjustified absences: 4 half-days per month and penalties
fact_en: From 4 half-days of unjustified absence in a month, the school head convenes the educational team to seek causes and propose support measures. After a warning from the Dasen (departmental education director), continued failure can bring a EUR 750 fine; if education is compromised, up to 2 years in prison and EUR 30,000.
fact_ko: 한 달에 정당한 사유 없는 결석이 4반일(demi-journées)에 이르면 학교장이 교육팀을 소집해 원인을 찾고 지원 조치를 제안한다. Dasen(지역 교육청장) 경고 후에도 지속되면 750유로 벌금, 교육이 위태로워지면 최대 징역 2년과 3만 유로 벌금이 부과될 수 있다.
legal_basis: Code de l'éducation art. L131-8 et L131-9; Code pénal art. 227-17-1
common_misconceptions: Threshold is 10 half-days
Threshold is 1 week
Fine is EUR 135
Family allowances are suspended automatically

title: 30 40: student distress helpline
fact_en: The 30 40 is a free and confidential listening, support and reporting service for higher-education students experiencing distress, violence or discrimination, where they can be put in touch with a psychologist or social worker.
fact_ko: 30 40은 고등교육 학생이 겪는 심리적 어려움, 폭력 또는 차별에 대해 경청·지원·신고를 제공하는 무료 비밀 보장 서비스로, 심리상담사나 사회복지사와 연결될 수 있다.
legal_basis: Service-Public.fr (DILA), Numéros d'urgence et d'écoute
